attacks.name: Reminiscence - Nightmare: Adam Smasher - Echo Skill 1
attacks.sourceText:
Cast Echo Skill to deal 16 instances of Physical DMG equal to 5.70% of ATK to enemies within range.
When Lucy or Rebecca has this Echo equipped in the main slot, their Crit. Rate is increased by 15% and they unlock special Echo Skills.
If equipped by Lucy:
- the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 152.00% of ATK to nearby enemies.
- Hold the Echo Skill button to deal Spectro DMG equal to 152.00% of ATK to nearby enemies and enter a special moving state, increasing Lucy's movement speed while slowing nearby enemies.
If equipped by Rebecca:
- Cast Echo Skill to fire missiles, dealing 16 instances of Electro DMG equal to 9.50% of ATK to enemies.
CD: 20s · Cast Echo Skill to deal 16 instances of Physical DMG equal to 6.84% of ATK to enemies within range.
